rules: Keep unavailable values null; do not infer zero or invent a source.
Use the supplied fixed source packet and exact task schema.
Signatures prove control of an ephemeral fixture key, not provider identity or task correctness.
A submission receipt is received_unreviewed and is not an award.
Deterministic fixture acceptance is practice only; it never earns live points.
Identical retries return the same receipt; conflicting retries and nonce replays fail.
